title: AgentOrch: How Close Can Global Orchestration Come to Step-by-Step Interaction?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise workflow agents typically rely on step-by-step interaction (Step-by-Step): the agent executes an action, observes its result, and invokes a large language model (LLM) again to decide the next step. Global orchestration (Global) instead generates a complete executable workflow in advance and executes it without further LLM calls, substantially reducing inference overhead, but it remains less accurate than Step-by-Step. We study how close Global can come to Step-by-Step and what narrows the remaining gap. We introduce AgentOrch, a benchmark that directly compares global orchestration with step-by-step interaction on 650 enterprise SOPs and 3,220 runtime variants under matched tools, environments, and evaluation. Step-by-Step remains more accurate for every evaluated model, but the gap has shrunk by about 79% from early models to the strongest recent model. translated_title: AgentOrch：全局编排与逐步交互还有多接近？
translated_abstract: 企业工作流智能体通常依赖于逐步交互（Step-by-Step）：智能体执行一个动作，观察其结果，然后再次调用大语言模型（LLM）来决定下一步。全局编排则预先生成一个完整的可执行工作流，并在无需进一步LLM调用的情况下执行它，从而大幅降低推理开销，但其准确性仍低于逐步交互。我们研究全局编排能达到多接近逐步交互的程度，以及是什么缩小了剩余的差距。我们提出AgentOrch，这是一个在匹配的工具、环境和评估条件下，直接比较全局编排与逐步交互的基准，涵盖650个企业标准操作程序（SOP）和3,220个运行时变体。对于每个被评估的模型，逐步交互仍然更准确，但从早期模型到最强的最新模型，这一差距已缩小约79%。我们确定了进一步缩小这一差距的三条路径。
tldr: 本文提出AgentOrch基准，在650个企业SOP及3,220个运行时变体上直接对比全局编排与逐步交互两种模式，发现两者的准确性差距已从早期模型到最新模型缩小约79%，并指出了进一步缩小差距的三条路径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentOrch, a benchmark that directly compares global orchestration with step-by-step interaction across 650 enterprise SOPs and 3,220 runtime variants, showing the accuracy gap has shrunk by about 79% from early to recent models and identifying three routes to further narrow it.
